title: LeakSmart Sensor Alert Weekly Battery Percent Trend
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=leaksmart:sensor battery_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(battery_pct) as avg_duration, max(battery_pct) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst battery percent for LeakSmart sensor alert events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture battery_pct on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average battery percent with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you whether LeakSmart sensor alert tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
